description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-delivery">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerReturn" name="Customer return"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderDelivery" name="Order and delivery" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received online or by phone">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAndSendConfirmation" name="Generate and send order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendTrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information to customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until delivery"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryReached" name="Has shipment reached customer's address?" default="Flow_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successful delivery"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Take further action"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Further action completed"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Customer return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionReturn" name="Take further action"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FurtherActionReturn" name="Further action completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Confirmation" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateAndSendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_PickPack" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAndSendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPack_Label" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_Handover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Handover_Tracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_DeliveryCheck" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipment has reached the customer's address</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered" name="Not yet" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Action" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" targetRef="End_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Action" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_End" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn" targetRef="End_FurtherActionReturn"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderDelivery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Order processing organization" processRef="Process_OrderDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAndSendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Customer return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
